title: A stable coordinate that is not a coordinate in four variables

abstractEnglish: We construct an explicit degree-five polynomial over $`\mathbf C`$ that is not a coordinate in four variables but becomes one after adjoining a single variable. This gives a counterexample to the stable coordinate conjecture in four variables. Every fiber is isomorphic to affine three-space, yet its embedding in affine four-space is not rectifiable. Thus the example also disproves the Abhyankar–Sathaye embedding conjecture in ambient dimension four.

details.overview: 该稿件在四变量多项式环中构造显式五次多项式，研究稳定坐标问题。摘要表示，该多项式在四变量中不是坐标，但添加一个变量后成为坐标，从而给出四变量稳定坐标猜想的反例。其每个纤维同构于仿射三维空间，但在仿射四空间中的嵌入不可矫正，因此也否证了环境维数为四的Abhyankar–Sathaye嵌入猜想。手稿为AI产生，未经独立审查或同行评议，结论应视为作者声称。
